responsibility: This autogenerated companion to vms.opt supplies the documentation URL suffix mappings for OpenVMS-specific command-line options in GCC’s generated option metadata. It associates each VMS target switch name with the anchor in the published GCC manual’s VMS Options section, so help, diagnostics, or tooling that surfaces option documentation can link parsed options such as -mmalloc64 and -mvms-return-codes to the correct manual location without embedding those URLs in the hand-written option definitions.
